description: Read one text file bundled with a skill, by its relative path (from skills_list_files), e.g. 'references/adaptive-fallback.md'. Binary files are not returned.

name.description: Skill name as returned by skills_list

offset.description: Character offset for long files; use the value given in a truncation note

path.description: Relative file path inside the skill, e.g. 'scripts/render_and_inspect.py'

name: skills_read_file
title: Read a skill file
